topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture series, outlines the learning outcomes, and establishes the overarching framework of cancer evolution and the microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Mechanisms of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how both sequential somatic mutations and non-mutational epigenetic alterations confer selective advantages that drive clonal expansion in pre-neoplastic tissues.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and the Cancer Stem Cell Model
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate how tissue hierarchies, stemness properties, and specific cells of origin govern tumor initiation and propagation across hematological and solid cancers.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion and the Integrated Evolutionary Framework
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how environmental promoters, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stroma cooperate with mutant cells to drive malignancy, alongside the analytical methods and synthesizing principles of cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
